items.name: drake-cave-e2
items.prompt: Turn this into the inside of the same volcano dragon cave, seen from the side, on a quiet cold morning after: the cave has been tidied in a hurry, all the gold coins, mugs and junk shoved into one heap in the left corner with a big round boulder pushed in front of it, and a huge lumpy hand-knitted tea cosy, far too big, poking out from behind the boulder. Warm orange lava glow from a crack in the back wall, dark rock walls and a rocky ceiling, a flat empty stone floor across the bottom fifth of the picture. No characters. Same painted style and colours.

items.name: drake-cave-2
items.prompt: slothadv style, the inside of a volcano dragon cave, warm lava glow, a heap of junk behind a boulder, a huge knitted tea cosy, flat stone floor. Soft painted storybook illustration, soft cel shading, thick dark outline, slothadv style.

items.name: drake-sit-2
items.prompt: Keep this exact same dragon: the same big grey-green armoured lizard drake, same reptile head with a long flat snout, same big plate scales and pale back spikes, same long tail, side view facing right. Change only his pose: he sits upright on his haunches facing right, front legs straight, tail curled round his feet, head up, calm but a little stiff and formal, like a nervous host, eyes open and kind. No mug. Solid flat pure bright magenta (#FF00FF) background.
items.neg: text, watermark, extra legs, extra heads, two dragons, sloth, fire, glow
